title: Case I (Serial 0573.00): Illustration of Flat Object with Protruding Cups, July 29, 1948
description: Shaded illustration of a flat, irregular, roughly S-shaped object covered with small round features, with dimension lines marked "6' to 8'" for length and "1-1/2' x 2'" for height. A callout reads "These are round cups which protrude". The surrounding text summarizes Case I, in which two rug-cleaning firm employees reported a shiny, metallic object gliding across a road at about 30 feet altitude, and opens Case II (Serial 4508.00). Page 78 of the report's summary of the 12 good UNKNOWN sightings.
